items.body:
This report concerns the `pygments` dependency, not a Rich defect, so it is labelled `upstream`. Dependency version bumps are handled by the maintainer; this issue is not a Rich bug.

A related earlier report about dependency advisories is #4044.

For a private vulnerability report, see https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/SECURITY.md

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
